book.hbk.recipes.page.1:
HBK RECIPES
Every mod recipe, including furnace and smithing recipes. The final pages explain food, trophies and events. Collect ingredients to unlock recipes in the green recipe book.
item.hbk.improved_boat.fuel_hint: RMB with fuel: load. Sneak + RMB: open tank
book.hbk.recipes.info.doshirak:
DENIS'S DOSHIRAK
Dry: 2 hunger, half a heart of damage. Combine with Kirill's Kettle; cook for 10 seconds. Drink for 3 hunger, regeneration I, +40% speed and +50% damage for 30 seconds. Returns an ordinary Kirill's Kettle.
book.hbk.recipes.info.funny_button:
FUNNY BUTTON
Diamond + any button + rofl block. Single-use. RMB: laughter, mobs within 50 blocks spin for 5s; aggressive mobs explode. Kirill Doomsday, Mad Liberal, Giant Stalin and Giant CJ only spin, immune to button blasts. Blocks intact. Cooldown: 5s.
book.hbk.recipes.info.dandruff:
GOSHA'S DANDRUFF
Every killed Gosha drops 1-4 flakes. RMB throws a flake like a snowball. Hits deal 5 damage (2.5 hearts). No crafting recipe: obtain it from Gosha.
book.hbk.recipes.info.feeding_onigiri:
FEEDING ONIGIRI
RMB any living mob, including bosses, to feed one onigiri. For 30 seconds it gains +60% outgoing damage and +150% speed. Feeding again refreshes the duration. RMB in the air eats it yourself.
book.hbk.recipes.info.lebedev_head:
LEBEDEV'S HEAD
Mad Liberal trophy. RMB a block to place it; walk into it or punch it to kick it around. RMB with an empty bucket collects blood without removing the head. RMB with another item picks it up. No crafting recipe.
book.hbk.recipes.info.liberal_blood:
LIBERAL BLOOD
RMB Lebedev's head with an empty bucket. Drink to clear all previous effects. For one minute: Young Liberal, −40% damage, +60% speed and jump strength, Regeneration I and Haste I. Returns an empty bucket. No recipe.
book.hbk.recipes.info.young_liberal:
YOUNG LIBERAL
White-blue-white flag icon. Higher world contrast. Bright pink daytime sky and bright blue night sky; vanilla flowers replace the stars. Normal vision and sky return when the minute ends.
book.hbk.recipes.info.bus:
BUS No.67
Arrives randomly. RMB during its 20-second stop to board. Randomly picks one of six destination types, then finds the nearest instance. Boarding produces smoke. A completed ride grants an advancement.

book.hbk.recipes.info.jagermeister:
JÄGERMEISTER
